title: Export Recording
gifInfo: GIF uses a 256-colour palette and a GIF-safe frame rate for smoother playback across apps. No audio, larger file size, best for short clips.
willOverwrite: A file already exists at this path and will be replaced.
ffmpegMissing: FFmpeg is not installed — export will fail.
selectOutputPath: Select an output path before exporting.
share_body: Upload this video to Director and copy a link anyone can watch.
share_plan: Free plan: links last 30 days, with a reminder email 3 days before they expire, for videos up to 10 minutes and up to 25 active links. Paid plans keep links forever.
share_signInBody: Share links need the optional Director sign-in. Everything else in Screenforge works without it.
share_backgroundUploading: Still uploading. The link is copied when it's done.
share_error_unsupported-format: Only MP4 and WebM videos can be shared as links. Export as MP4 or WebM to share this video.
share_error_file-missing: The exported file is gone. Export again to share it.
share_error_too-large: This video is over 4 GB, the most a share link can hold. Export at a lower resolution or quality.
share_error_too-long: On the free plan, shared videos can be up to 10 minutes. Trim the video or upgrade your Director plan.
share_error_limit-reached: The free plan allows 25 active links. Remove a link in Recordings or upgrade your Director plan.
share_error_signed-out: Director signed this app out. Sign in again to share.
share_error_interrupted: The upload was interrupted. Resume to continue where it stopped.
share_error_busy: Another video is still uploading. Try again when it's done.
share_error_not-found: Director no longer has this upload. Try again.
share_error_failed: Couldn't share the video. Try again.
